title: Credit Rating Simulator — Project Input
description: Derived from Core Rating Criteria v3.0, Appendix A (Section 14, enumerations) and Appendix B (Section 15, field dictionary). Hand-authored directly from those sections — there is no executable generator; keep this file consistent with CORE Appendix A/B by hand whenever either changes. EVERY PERCENTAGE IS A DECIMAL FRACTION (CORE Section 9.6). Enumerated values are matched on CODE, never on display text (CORE Section 14).

accumulated_losses.description: In the unit declared at currency_unit

actual_gen_vs_p90_period.description: Decimal fraction, NOT a percentage out of 100. 0.9700 means 97% (CORE Section 9.6). No upper bound is imposed: a share cannot exceed 1, but a ratio expressed as a fraction can - actual_gen_vs_p90_* legitimately exceeds 1.0000 whenever a project outperforms its P90 estimate. Range rules that depend on the field are enforced by the engine, not by this schema.

Range rules that depend on the field are enforced by the engine, not by this schema. Legitimately null for projects with fewer than 3 years of operating history.

debt_instruments.description: Instrument-level debt build. Treatment is stored per instrument because it moves CORE Sections 5.1 and 5.2 by whole tiers (CORE Section 9.3). A blank treatment is a null, not a default; validation rule V14 blocks it.

treatment.description: Default is TREATMENT_DEBT for every instrument, including subordinated sponsor loans and CCDs. TREATMENT_EQUITY requires all three CORE Section 9.3 conditions to be affirmatively satisfied.

offtakers.description: Up to FOUR individual counterparties, largest first by contracted share. A fifth aggregated line is carried separately in other_offtakers_*. Shares across the individual lines and the aggregated line must sum to 1.0000 +/- 0.0100 (V3).

rating_or_grade.description: C&I: SEBI national long-term scale, AAA to D with modifiers on AA to C. DISCOM: MoP/PFC grade A+, A, B, B-, C, C-, D.

more_recent_published.description: A missing or superseded edition or date is flagged stale per CORE Section 9.9 and raises V12 Warn. It is never silently applied.

anyOf.title: Schedule route — minimum_dscr and average_dscr are DERIVED from the schedule and must not also be entered
Direct-entry route — Section 4.2 has no operand, average_dscr is a non-critical null, V1 returns Not Evaluated

x-critical-note: CORE Section 9.8.1: a null in any required field returns "Insufficient Input — Not Rated" and stops the pipeline at Stage 1 (Section 10.1.1). CONDITIONAL CRITICALITY CANNOT BE EXPRESSED IN JSON SCHEMA: offtakers[].type and offtakers[].rating_or_grade are critical only where that offtaker's contracted_share >= 0.2500. Schema validation will pass without them; the engine must still reject at Stage 1. Schema-valid does NOT mean ready to score.
